config.description: The universal MANUAL-BUFF escape-hatch (custom_buffs.<key>) via the buffs bag (setBuffsSettings — the no-teammate passthrough enemy-state uses). Her always-present ConditionCustomBuffs (CustomBuffs.js:9-23, registered db/Buffs/ElementalResonance.js:70-74) regex-strips `custom_buffs.` and ADDITIVELY injects the suffix as a RAW stat (stats.add); processPercent (Stats.js:119-125,327-337) folds percent keys /100 once over the bag. Loop is KEY-GENERIC → one key per emit-LANE proves the lane (one element proves all 8 dmg_<element>). Three reps span the three OUTPUT KINDS: custom-buffs-damage (Diluc) drives atk:500 (flat — bare atk is NOT percent) / atk_percent:40 (0.40) / crit_rate:30 (0.30) / crit_dmg:60 (0.60) / dmg_pyro:50 (0.50, lifts pyro skill/burst) / dmg_normal:25 (0.25, lifts normals) / enemy_def_ignore:20 (0.20, lifts all) — six already-emitted lanes, RED driven by the missing condition (every damage triple shifts). custom-buffs-shield (Noelle skill shield) shield:50 (.*shield → 0.50) — the ANTI-HOLLOW-GREEN key: RED until BOTH the condition AND the genuinely-new out['shield'] emit land (our buildStats emits no shield today → undershoots 50%). custom-buffs-heal (Sangonomiya Kokomi heal_dot+kokomi_burst_heal, read cStat('healing')) healing:30 (^healing → 0.30) — the healing lane already emits (HEAL_BONUS_KEYS), RED driven by the missing condition (undershoots 30%). customBuffsBurndown burns them RED until Task B ports the condition + shield emit.
